attempts.sql: SELECT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols c ON c.file_id = g.file_id AND c.name = 'Command' AND c.kind = 'class' JOIN code.symbols cm ON cm.file_id = c.file_id AND cm.qualname = 'Command.' || g.name AND cm.kind = 'method' WHERE g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND g.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND g.kind = 'method' ORDER BY g.symbol_id

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds methods defined in the Group class in src/click/core.py and joins them to methods defined directly in the Command class in the same file with the same bare name, which identifies overrides of methods Command itself defines (including __init__). Returns the Group method symbol IDs.
sql: SELECT g.symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols c ON c.file_id = g.file_id AND c.name = 'Command' AND c.kind = 'class' JOIN code.symbols cm ON cm.file_id = c.file_id AND cm.qualname = 'Command.' || g.name AND cm.kind = 'method' WHERE g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND g.qualname LIKE 'Group.%' AND g.kind = 'method' ORDER BY g.symbol_id
